description: This file contains ASN.1 structure definitions and type aliases related to 3GPP NR RRC UE variables, including various sequence and choice structures used in 5G NR protocol implementation.

classes.name: cli_triggered_list_r16_c
classes.description: Choice structure for CLI-triggered list, can hold either SRS-RSRP or RSSI-triggered list.

classes.name: cells_triggered_list_item_c_
classes.description: Choice structure for cell list items, can be PCI, EUTRA PCI, or UTRA PCI.

classes.name: sn_pn_id_r18_s
classes.description: Structure representing SNPN identity with PLMN ID and a 44-bit ID.

classes.name: var_app_layer_idle_r18_s
classes.description: Sequence representing application layer idle configuration for 5G NR.

classes.name: var_log_meas_cfg_r16_s
classes.description: Sequence for logging measurement configuration, including report type and measurement lists.

classes.name: var_meas_report_s
classes.description: Sequence representing measurement report with various triggered lists and identifiers.

classes.name: var_ra_report_r16_s
classes.description: Sequence for RA (Random Access) report, including identity list and other parameters.

classes.name: var_rlf_report_r16_s
classes.description: Sequence for RLF (Radio Link Failure) report with identity list.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a choice type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bitstream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bitstream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.
